sam_cs: Quick ask10am kickoff with BrightArc. They want a pocket runbook: one non-technical page for PMs + a paste-ready engineer snippet focused on caching, batching, streaming. Keep it tiny, high impact.

ivy_csm: I can write the PM page. Want three profiles (safe/balanced/throughput) with copyable numbers?

mike_sre: Yes. My engineer defaults: safe: ttl=30s batch=8; balanced: ttl=120s batch=16; throughput: ttl=300s batch=32 (GPU). streaming chunk=128 tokens. Warm pools first 48h.

jen_support: Add day checklist: Day0 smoke (support), Day1 prime (CS), Day3 telemetry (CS+SRE), Day7 renewal-check (CS+AE). Flag if p95>350ms or cache_hit<25%.

mike_sre: Paste snippet for engineers (single block they can copy):

CACHE_PROFILE=safe; TTL=30; BATCH=8; STREAM_CHUNK=128; KV_MB=64

# Troubleshooting hints
# check cache hit: redwoodctl metrics query --cust brightarc --metric cache_hit_ratio --window 24h
# tail stream errors: redwoodctl logs tail --cust brightarc --filter "stream_error" --since 1h

jen_support: Also include 3-question Day7 feedback (yes/no + short note): quality ok? slow responses? streaming artifacts? We'll ingest replies into CS dashboard.

sam_cs: Owners: Ivy=PM one-pager + email, Mike=engineer snippet + triage, Jen=run Day0 and Day3. ops-bot: schedule prefill job for BrightArc tomorrow.

ops-bot: scheduled: "prefill-top-keys" for brightarc at 2025-06-15T09:00:00Z :gear:

sam_cs: Great, I'll publish the one-pager and attach the snippet. Keep thread for follow-ups.
